targetText: Together with a truly barbarous squandering of production forces, with the destruction of the material means of production and of the living labour power, together with the devitalisation of economy through monstrous socially harmful expenditures, the war, like a gigantic crisis, has intensified the fundamental tendencies of capitalist development; it has hastened to an extraordinary degree the growth of finance capitalist relations and the centralisation of capital on a world scale.
summary: Imperialist world war acts as a gigantic crisis that destroys productive forces while vastly accelerating finance-capitalist centralization and state capitalism.
explanation: Bukharin documents how World War I wiped out small enterprises, subordinated entire national economies to state-capitalist war syndicates, and propelled the United States to global financial supremacy.
